title: Working Python: Practical Automation and Scripting in 20 Days
summary: A focused, hands-on curriculum designed to bring an independent learner to working fluency in Python. Emphasizes everyday utilities, text and data processing, file automation, and defensive programming in 30-minute daily increments.

days.title: Variables, Numeric Types, and Input
objectives: Assign variables using standard Python naming conventions
Calculate totals with integer and float arithmetic using rupee and tax examples
Collect and convert user input from the terminal using int() and float()

days.title: String Formatting and Cleaning
objectives: Format output dynamically using Python f-strings
Clean user-entered text using strip(), lower(), and replace()
Extract substrings using basic string slicing

days.title: Conditional Logic and Decisions
objectives: Write multi-branch decisions using if, elif, and else
Evaluate conditions with comparison and boolean operators (and, or, not)
Compute bracketed pricing such as tiered electricity or GST rates

days.title: Repetition with While and For Loops
objectives: Iterate over numeric sequences using for loops and range()
Construct while loops with terminating conditions and counter updates
Control loop execution flow using break and continue statements

days.title: Interactive CLI Utility
objectives: Combine loops, conditionals, and input to build an interactive command-line bill splitter
Validate terminal input against expected choices
Debug common syntax and indentation mistakes systematically

days.title: Lists and Sequence Operations
objectives: Create and modify lists using append(), insert(), and pop()
Extract subsets of data using list slicing syntax
Sort and reverse lists in place and using sorted()

days.title: Key-Value Mapping with Dictionaries
objectives: Store and retrieve structured data using dictionary keys
Update dictionary values and add new key-value pairs safely using get()
Iterate over dictionary keys, values, and items

days.title: Sets, Tuples, and Deduplication
objectives: Create immutable records using tuples
Eliminate duplicate items from a list by casting to a set
Perform set operations including union, intersection, and difference

days.title: Navigating Nested Data Structures
objectives: Index and update values inside lists of dictionaries
Flatten simple two-dimensional data collections
Filter a list of record dictionaries based on specific field criteria

days.title: List and Dictionary Comprehensions
objectives: Transform sequences concisely using list comprehensions
Filter data inline using conditional comprehensions
Construct lookup tables using dictionary comprehensions

days.title: Writing Modular Functions
objectives: Define reusable functions with def, parameters, and explicit return values
Trace variable scope between local function bodies and global scripts
Document function contracts with concise docstrings

days.title: Function Arguments and Return Patterns
objectives: Set sensible parameter defaults for optional configuration
Pass arguments using explicit keyword syntax
Return multiple values from a single function using tuple unpacking

days.title: Defensive Programming and Error Handling
objectives: Intercept runtime crashes using try, except, and finally blocks
Catch specific errors such as ValueError, KeyError, and FileNotFoundError
Raise custom exceptions to halt execution on invalid business logic

days.title: Standard Library: Math, Random, and Datetime
objectives: Calculate dates, past deltas, and deadlines using the datetime module
Format timestamps into readable regional strings with strftime()
Generate random samples and selections using the random module

days.title: Text File Input and Output
objectives: Read raw text files safely using the with open() context manager
Write and append processed log lines to text files
Iterate through files line by line to keep memory footprint minimal

days.title: Working with CSV Files
objectives: Parse tabular records using the built-in csv.reader and csv.DictReader
Write structured records to a spreadsheet-compatible CSV file using csv.DictWriter
Compute column summaries such as total spend across monthly expenses

days.title: Parsing and Generating JSON Data
objectives: Serialize Python dictionaries and lists into valid JSON strings and files
Deserialize raw JSON payloads from text files into Python data structures
Extract nested fields from standard JSON responses

days.title: Pattern Matching with Regular Expressions
objectives: Validate text formats such as 6-digit Indian PIN codes and phone numbers using re.search()
Extract repeated structured entities from unstructured text using re.findall()
Sanitize inconsistent text fields using re.sub()

days.title: Scripts, Arguments, and Virtual Environments
objectives: Isolate project dependencies using venv and pip
Parse script command-line arguments using sys.argv
Format and freeze project dependencies into a requirements.txt file

days.title: Capstone: Automated Expense Audit Tool
objectives: Write an end-to-end Python script that ingests a CSV log of daily transactions
Audit the dataset for anomalies and compute category-wise totals
Export a formatted summary text report and structured JSON output to disk
